content:
emeric: FYI: courier just calledthey're delivering a demo acrylic display (heavy) and a large potted tree for vendor showcase tomorrow at 10:30. They say both downstairs now. Who can meet?
reception: We'll hold at the loading bay and can sign for both, but need escort and storage plan. Any special handling notes?
vendor-bot: Shipment details: 1x acrylic display (120cm x 80cm), weight ~25kg. 1x potted tree (Monstera, 1.8m), soil-filled pot, marked 'Fragile: roots'. Tracking: https://courier.example/track/ZX-9921
jas: Oof the tree pot will be a mess if it tips. We should request dolly and floor tarp. I can meet at 10:20 and bring the dolly.
leo: I can help move the display into Conf C (glass table area). It needs a two-person lift for the base.
emeric: Reception, can you reserve a corner in the west storage (near locker 5) for the tree overnight? We don't want it in the main mail pile.
reception: Locker 5 is occupied but we can clear shelf B. Note: do not store plants under fluorescent fixtures. Also please fill out the 'Special Delivery' form: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-special-delivery
people-ops-bot: Reminder: anyone escorting external vendors needs a visitor badge and ID check. Use prefilled guest form to speed up.
maya: Vendor rep will have ID. I'll be escort and badge holder. @jas can you bring a drop cloth? We had soil spill last month. :grimacing:
jas: Yes, bringing tarp and some cardboard sheets. Also packing tape in case the pot's rim needs shoring.
leo: Do we have a dolly with straps? Last time straps were missing.
emeric: There's a folding dolly in the janitor closet, straps in the maintenance bin (label: MAINT-STRAP). I'll grab them.
reception: Courier ETA 10:27. Please come down to the ramp. Plate number reported: 7B-PLT.
jason: (reacts :eyes:)
jas: On my way. ETA 10:18.
maya: I'll have the guest form filled and badge ready. Leaving Conf C clear.
leo: Once we move the display, let's snap a quick photo and post in #packages so ops knows where it is.
reception: Received both items, photos uploaded to #packages. Locker shelf B cleared and labeled 'Vendor Monstera'. Code for access tonight will be shared with people-ops.
emeric: Thanks team. Quick follow-up: can someone water the plant tomorrow morning? Not sure vendor will. @maya?
maya: I can water it before 9am.
people-ops-bot: Done. Checklist: badges issued, photos posted, dolly + straps used, tarp deployed, storage assigned. Closing thread.
